description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. The download page now supports aggregated CurseForge + Modrinth search with merged, deduplicated results; MultiMC modpack import is synced from upstream HMCL, and the download provider system follows the upstream refactor.
2. Main screen right menu layout reworked; "Execute Jar" moved into the Java management dialog; the renderer selection dialog now auto-scrolls to the currently selected renderer.
3. Added an FCL easter egg dialog, triggered with a pity probability when launching the game.
4. Version lists now use a session-level snapshot cache for instant page switching; sorting uses real game version numbers in descending order, and manual refresh invalidates the cache.
5. FCLNumberSeekBar track is now self-drawn, breaking and rounding around the value text; theme derived-color alpha became a separate setting, so the background no longer disappears when the theme color is fully transparent.
6. Version icons now load pixel-aware everywhere, keeping low-resolution pixel-art icons sharp when scaled up; the NeoForge version icon was replaced.
7. Fixed game crashes caused by SDL reused windows being destroyed early; SDL IME now routes by render path, so the soft keyboard works with Controlify.
8. The embedded Microsoft login page now closes automatically on login completion, and Back exits directly; fixed stacked login pages caused by leaked OAuth listeners.
9. Fixed the navigation bar staying on top and covering bottom buttons after returning from multitasking, skin translucency voxel stripes, SeekBar row reuse writing wrong data, background crashes from an empty download-provider cache, and goSetting not switching pages when already selected.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.下载页支持 CurseForge 与 Modrinth 聚合搜索，双源结果合并去重；同步上游 HMCL 的 MultiMC 整合包导入；下载源体系跟进上游重构
2.主界面右菜单布局调整，执行 Jar 功能移入 Java 管理对话框；渲染器选择对话框打开时自动定位到当前选中的渲染器
3.新增 FCL 弹窗彩蛋，点击启动游戏按保底概率触发
4.版本列表接入会话级快照缓存，切换页面即显；排序改用真实游戏版本号降序，手动刷新强制失效缓存
5.FCLNumberSeekBar 轨道改为自绘，数值文本两侧断开并圆角收口；主题派生色透明度改为独立设置项，主色全透明时背景不再不可见
6.版本图标全面接入像素感知加载，低分辨率像素风图标放大不再发糊；更换 NeoForge 版本图标
7.修复 SDL 复用窗口被提前销毁导致游戏崩溃；SDL 输入法按渲染路径分流，Controlify 环境可正常呼出软键盘
8.微软登录结束时自动关闭内嵌登录页，返回键直接退出；修复 OAuth 事件监听残留导致堆叠多个登录页
9.修复多任务返回后导航栏常驻遮挡底部按钮、皮肤半透明体素化条纹、SeekBar 行复用误写数据、下载源空缓存后台崩溃、goSetting 已选中不切页等问题
